description: Election Commission - D. D. Ranaweera was selected as the member of the Nuwaragam Palatha Central Pradeshiya Sabha - N. Yoganathan was selected as the member of the Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to death and resignation, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of new members through political party processes, which falls under electoral processes and related matters. This fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns candidate nominations and declarations for local authority positions.
